name: verification-before-completion
description: Ensure the task is actually done before declaring completion. Run the full test suite, verify the build, check the diff for unintended changes, and confirm acceptance criteria are met. 'Seems right' is never sufficient. Inspired by superpowers.

inputs.name: acceptanceCriteria
inputs.description: List of acceptance criteria to verify.

outputs.name: verificationReport
outputs.description: Report: testSuitePassed, buildPassed, diffClean, criteriaMet, readyToShip.

failureConditions.signal: npm run build exits with non-zero
git diff shows files outside the task scope
one or more criteria are not verified
